O.content: The chart shows temperature labels, year ticks, and axis labeling, but no visible text states a substantial-change threshold or routing rule.

B.text: If a substantial-change route requires an explicit displayed policy threshold or other supplied criterion, the chart alone does not establish that the full-period change meets it; under a policy that defaults unverified changes to routine monitoring, routine monitoring would apply.
B.conditions: The supplied task names the criterion but provides no numeric threshold or default-routing policy; the routine-monitoring implication is conditional on such a default policy.

O.content: The title reads "River Temperature Monitoring Record," and the vertical axis is labeled "Water temperature (°C)."

O.location: 2005 x-axis tick and first plotted marker
O.content: A plotted marker above the 2005 tick has the printed label "23.9°C" next to it.

O.location: 2014 x-axis tick and final plotted marker
O.content: A plotted marker above the 2014 tick has the printed label "10.1°C" next to it.

B.text: If the plotted series is the river-temperature record, the x-axis year ticks bind the endpoint markers to 2005 and 2014, and the printed endpoint labels are their temperatures in °C, then the full-period change is 2014 minus 2005. If the routing program classifies a decrease of that magnitude as substantial, substantial-change follow-up is the applicable route.
B.conditions: Applies only if the endpoint labels accurately annotate the plotted river-temperature series and if the program's unstated substantial-change criterion includes the derived magnitude.
